raw.query: WITH i AS (SELECT lead_s, COUNT(*) AS metric_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_violation) AS violating_rows, STRING_AGG(sla_metric || '=' || ROUND(achieved_p99_ms::numeric, 3) || 'ms>' || ROUND(bound_ms::numeric, 0) || 'ms', ', ' ORDER BY sla_metric) AS infractions, MIN(n_requests) AS n_requests, MAX(n_requests) AS max_n_requests FROM provenance.v_infraction WHERE is_current = true AND experiment = 'a11' AND window_name = 'burst3' AND policy = 'reactive' GROUP BY lead_s), p AS (SELECT lead_s, COUNT(*) AS latency_rows, MIN(n_requests) AS n_requests, MAX(n_requests) AS max_n_requests FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current = true AND experiment = 'a11' AND window_name = 'burst3' AND policy = 'reactive' GROUP BY lead_s) SELECT i.lead_s, i.metric_rows, i.violating_rows, i.infractions, i.n_requests, (i.n_requests = i.max_n_requests AND i.n_requests = p.n_requests AND p.n_requests = p.max_n_requests AND i.metric_rows = p.latency_rows) AS comparable FROM i JOIN p USING (lead_s) ORDER BY i.lead_s
